command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "48d20ed7e17107a3d1378a394b12b5382ae58a49" ]
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
idf.py reconfigure >/dev/null
ROOT=managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib
printf '%s\n' '=== command-related headers ==='
find "$ROOT" -type f | grep -Ei '(zcl|command|on.?off|level)' | sort | head -n 200
printf '%s\n' '=== On/Off and Level API symbols ==='
grep -RniE 'on.?off|level.?control|move.?to.?level|toggle|cmd_req' "$ROOT"/include | head -n 500 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== exact public declarations around likely command APIs ==='
grep -RniE -C 4 'esp_zb_zcl.*(on_off|level)|on_off.*cmd|level.*cmd|move_to_level|toggle' "$ROOT"/include | head -n 500 || true
